attributes.residual: MIXED and CAPPED, with a SIXTH axis now closed on Part B and its failure mechanism named for the first time. PART A (26 of 30 tokens): the settled address-PRE add/stfs/stw versus addi/stfsx/stwx family, closed by law plus a four-variant cap; not reopened, not probed. PART B (the 2 surplus instructions at @5d8): the joint empty-body-plus-volatile form fails for a reason neither parent law predicted, and the aligned view shows exactly why. Emptying the body does not merely elide the guard's own comparison -- it removes the last obstacle to constant-propagating `selected` into the code BELOW the guard, so the downstream `selected * 3` folds to zero and the target's `mulli r0,r21,12` + `lfsx f1,r22,r0` indexed access collapses into a single `lfs f1,3092(r29)`. The volatile qualifier did NOT rescue this: the volatile load survived but was SUNK past the fold to 0x5dc, proving volatile anchors the LOAD only and never the COMPARE, which is the precondition the SI dead-store law actually needs and cannot supply here. Net effect is 4 instructions removed where only 2 were surplus, hence O417 against target 419. Six axes are now closed on this cluster across three sessions: empty body, initializer-at-declaration, dead-store body, dead-store + volatile, live body + volatile, and empty body + volatile. The handoff is UNCHANGED and now better supported: nothing portable makes our own constant-initialised local unknown at the guard without changing the program, and any form that stops the propagation locally re-enables it downstream. Do not spend further probes on body shape or on qualifier placement at this site.
